diagnostics.logsHint: What this page logged since it was opened. It stays on your device until you share it.
diagnostics.calibrationHint: Your wearable data of the last 30 days without dates or names, to paste into a bug report. Nothing is sent by itself.
diagnostics.review_one: {{count}} day. Check it before you share it.
diagnostics.review_other: {{count}} days. Check them before you share them.

updates.envOff: Update checks are turned off by the server's environment.
updates.how: Trace builds its backends from forks: update by merging upstream into the fork and deploying Trace again.
updates.offNotice: Update checks are off: Trace won't tell you about new releases, security fixes included.
updates.intervalHint: How often Trace looks for a new version of itself while it is in the background.

about.what: Nutrition, cooking and training in one app, on the servers of NutriTrace, CookTrace and LiftTrace.
about.license: Trace is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License 3.0.
about.builtOnHint: The three servers and the logic of their apps come from TraceApps (AGPL-3.0).
about.offData: Food data from Open Food Facts (ODbL)
about.supportHint: If these apps are useful to you, you can support TraceApps.
about.medical: Not a medical device. Nutrition values, scores and estimates can be wrong and don't replace advice from a doctor or dietitian.
about.training: Exercise carries a risk of injury. Check programs and weights against your own ability, and ask a professional if unsure.
about.ai: The assistant is an AI. It can be wrong; check what it says and what it adds.

features.areas: Food diary, recipes, pantry and workouts in one app
features.selfHosted: Self-hosted: your data stays on your server
features.pwa: Installs as a web app on phone and computer
features.privacy: No tracking, no ads, no third-party analytics

about.federation: CookTrace reads foods from NutriTrace, and LiftTrace sends it your workouts, once connected.
